How to test DDDA Coop 0.11.1 with friends
========================================

Before
------
- Everyone: the game up to date. Steam: Steam friends with the host.
  GOG (or Steam with a GOG friend): direct IP, see "GOG and direct IP" in README.txt; the host's
  address from their "Lobby"; over the internet, UDP port 27101 open on the host's router.
- Everyone: the same mod version (0.11.1). Unzip it in a folder of its own (not the game folder),
  open DDDA-Coop.exe. It must say "Game version supported".
  Windows may warn that the program is not signed: "More info", then "Run anyway".
- Keep "Detailed log" on ("Settings").

Start, in this order
--------------------
1. Host: "Host", "Launch the game", load their game.
2. Each friend: "Guest", "Launch the game", and STAY on the title screen until "Connected!".
3. Only then: Start, load a game. The friend arrives with their own character; the host's game
   saves and reloads for a few seconds.
One friend at a time is easier to follow if something goes wrong.

Try
---
- Walk and fight together; go through a door or a gate.
- Host talks to an NPC, sleeps at the inn.
- A friend quits and comes back.
- A friend explores alone (LB + RB + Y for 1.5 s, or F7) and comes back the same way.
- Light the lantern; change a piece of gear in the menu.
- New in 0.11.1, please try:
  - Enter the same area together (Bitterblack Isle, the underground, the open world): every screen
    should show the same monsters and enemy groups.
  - Lift a jar, a barrel or a crate (RT) and walk with it: the others should see it in your hands.
    Throw it: if it breaks, it should be gone on every screen.
- From 0.11.0:
  - With Discord open on your PC: your Discord profile should show "Playing DDDA Coop", your
    vocation and level, host or guest, where you are, and the number of players. Walk to another
    place: it changes within a few seconds. Untick it in the launcher: it goes away.
  - Grab another player (Hold): they should stay in your hands, never thrown far away.
- Still to check from 0.10.2:
  - Fight together: the monsters should attack and move the same way on every screen.
  - Shoot with a bow or a staff, also aiming with the mouse: the others should see the shots go
    where you aim.
  - Pick up, throw or push a crate or a barrel: it should end up at the same place for everyone.
  - Split up in a big area (the underground, the open world), then meet again: the monsters
    should not jump or swap.
  - If an ogre grabs someone: where does that player stand on the other screens?
- Avoid the Rift and the game's online features.

If something goes wrong
-----------------------
- No Steam friend found in the game: be Steam friends, and in Dragon's Dogma.
- Direct IP, "No answer from the host": check the address, that the host loaded their game, and
  the host's UDP port 27101 (router, Windows firewall: allow DDDA.exe when Windows asks).
- GOG, "Connection failed" when loading: press A or Enter, the game loads.
- "Host not found" after a minute: restart the friend's game.
- A crash or anything odd: note the time and what you were doing.

After
-----
- Everyone: "Log" > "Export the log", and send the files from Documents\DDDA Coop\Journaux,
  saying who you are. After a crash, export before starting the game twice (the log of the game
  before is kept as "-previous").
- Friends, back to your own game: "Solo" (your co-op gains are added) or "Remove the mod".
